name: Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple, Dharmapuri
address: Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple, Boyawada, Dharmapuri, Jagtial District, Telangana 505425
main_deity: Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy (presiding deity, worshipped also in Yoga Narasimha and Ugra Narasimha forms)
other_deities: Sri Ramalingeshwara Swamy (installed by Lord Rama)
description: Dharmapuri Kshetram is a sacred land and living confluence of Sanatana Dharma, magnificent historical heritage, and artistic grandeur, nestled on the banks of the holy River Godavari flowing as 'Dakshina Vahini' (southward flow). It is revered as one of the nine sacred Narasimha abodes (Nava Narasimha Kshetram) in India and serves as a powerful Hari-Hara Kshetram symbolizing spiritual unity between Shaivite and Vaishnavite traditions.
history: The temple heritage endures from the era of King Dharmavarma of Vidarbha to the present day as a unique stream preserving Vedic knowledge and fine arts. The Kshetram has been patronised over a millennium by prominent dynasties including the Chalukyas, Rashtrakutas, and the Recharla Velama chiefs. It has also been enriched by literary luminaries like Sheshappa Kavi and Pingali Surana.
mythology: Dharmapuri finds explicit mention in several sacred Puranas including the Skandha Purana and Brahmanda Purana. It is celebrated as a primary center for devotion and spiritual liberation since Puranic times. Lord Ramalingeshwara Swamy deity was installed by Lord Rama. A unique physical synthesis exists at the Satyavati temple where Lord Narasimha is placed directly on top of a Shiva Panamattam.

sub_temples.name: Satyavati Temple
sub_temples.significance: A unique physical testament to Hari-Hara synthesis where Lord Narasimha is placed directly on top of a Shiva Panamattam.

sub_temples.name: Sri Ramalingeshwara Swamy Temple
sub_temples.significance: Shaivite shrine featuring Sri Ramalingeshwara Swamy, installed by Lord Rama himself.

sub_temples.name: Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple
sub_temples.significance: Shrine dedicated to Sri Venkateswara Swamy whose chariot and procession participate alongside Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy during Brahmotsavams.

sub_temples.name: Sri Yoga Narasimha Swamy Shrine
sub_temples.significance: Dedicated shrine for the Yoga form of Lord Narasimha, feature of special Dolotsavam and Ekantotsavam rituals.

sub_temples.name: Sri Ugra Narasimha Swamy Shrine
sub_temples.significance: Dedicated shrine for the Ugra form of Lord Narasimha, featuring Teppotsavam, Dolotsavam, and Ekantotsavam rituals.

architecture.style: Ancient traditional South Indian temple architecture with stone structures, double-storied tiled village surroundings, and sacred riverfront ghats

highlights.name: Satyavati Temple Shiva Panamattam Installation
highlights.description: Unique architectural and iconographic synthesis where Lord Narasimha is installed directly on top of a Shiva Panamattam.

highlights.name: Dharmapuri Temple Arch Kaman
highlights.description: Main entrance arch serving as the primary gateway and perimeter control point for the temple complex.

highlights.name: Koneru Pond
highlights.description: Sacred water tank within the temple complex with stone steps.

highlights.name: Dharmapuri Godavari River Bathing Ghats
highlights.description: Long flight of stone steps leading down to the Dakshina Vahini Godavari River with traditional village architectural framing.
